mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_order SET status='WAITING',verified_at=#{verifiedAt},settle_days_snapshot=#{settleDays}, eligible_at=#{eligibleAt},due_schedule_round=#{dueScheduleRound}, source_verified_event_id=COALESCE(source_verified_event_id,#{sourceVerifiedEventId}), hold_reason=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING_TRIGGER'

UPDATE settlement_order SET status='SPLITTING',split_amount=#{splitAmount},platform_retained_amount=#{platformRetainedAmount}, platform_subsidy_due=#{platformSubsidyDue},active_instruction_id=#{instructionId}, hold_reason=NULL,last_error_code=NULL,last_error_message=NULL, version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='WAITING'
